propositions: The LLM runtime is provider-agnostic in name but hardcoded to Anthropic, selecting behavior by matching provider-name strings like startswith("anthropic").
rebar has no native AWS Bedrock path despite clients reaching Claude via Bedrock more often than the direct Anthropic API.
_pai_check_config refuses base_url/api_key even though documentation and config parsing already treat REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL/REBAR_LLM_API_KEY as working, making the docs false.
Provider selection should route through a single pydantic-ai provider_factory and providers.py registry, with capabilities read from ModelProfile instead of name-set matching.
Bedrock first-class support must achieve retry and timeout parity via botocore adaptive mode and aws_read_timeout rather than the httpx tenacity transport.
Signed verdict sidecars should carry structured provenance (provider, endpoint host, tier, capabilities) distinguishing first-class from best-effort verdicts.
